description: NaBeO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.56 Å. There are two inequivalent Be sites. In the first Be site, Be is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.71 Å) Be-O bond lengths. In the second Be site, Be is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.70 Å) Be-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Be atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Be atoms.
